database: Fresh disposable PostgreSQL container with --network none; existing local databases untouched; container removed after successful run
checks: Injected migration failure rolls back added functions and preserves the prior public table catalog.
Company-scoped progress reader excludes raw cursor, scope key, secret references and private job payload; anonymous and service roles cannot invoke it.
Viewer can inspect progress but cannot approve; foreign-company read and private helper access refused.
Fresh owner approval continues from the saved cursor with unchanged provider bounds, new page budget and renewed 24-hour consent.
Prior immutable approval and checkpoint retained; new checkpoint uses compact scope key compatible with the worker binding.
Exact request retries return the original receipt; changed request identity, stale state and active duplicate work refused.
Repeated source publication does not duplicate message versions; reviewed restart retains previous checkpoint and resets only the new batch cursor/pages.
Injected queue failure rolls back checkpoint replacement and new approval atomically.
Completed window cannot recover; original setup can approve the next bounded window.
Controlled blocked transactions prove revoked owner and changed connection are reread; two competing approvals queue one job.
Existing synthetic emails, Slack messages and source versions remain unchanged.
Twelve Node tests passed: six history recovery client tests and six existing thread client tests.
Focused strict TypeScript check passed for the recovery client and tests; git diff whitespace check passed.
limitations: Local migration and client adapter only. Hosted TEST remains release 013, worker runtime v4; no hosted release or browser recovery UI yet.
Synthetic SQL uses an ID-only auth stand-in, not hosted auth/provider acceptance. No real Slack requests, customer-data changes, new credentials or schedules.
Recovery is owner/admin-reviewed for the same incomplete channel window, up to ten pages per new approval. It does not enable continuous ingestion, thread recovery or unlimited backfill.
pagesThisApproval is the current batch count, not lifetime imported pages or a coverage guarantee; previous approval IDs/checkpoints are retained.
Client preserves caller-supplied request identity for retries but does not implement a durable browser outbox.
Actual Slack permissions, multi-window capture, voicemail ingestion and wider LEARN V1 remain outstanding.
